feeds.title: FlowingData Blog
feeds.description: FlowingData explores how statisticians, designers, and computer scientists are using data to help us understand more about ourselves and surroundings, mainly through visualization.

feeds.title: AnyChart JS Charts Blog and DataViz Weekly
feeds.description: One of the global leaders in data visualization, AnyChart offers an award-winning JavaScript charting library to help web developers easily visualize any data in any chart or dashboard, accessible on any platform and in any browser. In addition to tips and news, the blog is where they publish DataViz Weekly featuring the best new data visualization examples from around the web every week.

feeds.title: Michael Sandberg's Data Visualization Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Data Visualization, Infographics, Business Intelligence, Historical Aspects of Data Visualization (e.g., John Snow's Cholera Map) and Storytelling.

feeds.title: Visual Capitalist - Rich Visual Content For The Modern Investor
feeds.description: Visual Capitalist is a media site that creates and curates visual content focused on trends in business and investing.

feeds.title: Depict Data Studio
feeds.description: Transform your technical information for non-technical audiences through better data visualizations, reports, slideshows, and dashboards. Depict Data Studio provides workshops, webinars, conference keynotes, coaching sessions, and custom design projects.

feeds.title: Storytelling With Data
feeds.description: At storytelling with data, we share practical tips and examples on how to effectively communicate with data. Storytelling With Data is a blog written by Cole Nussbaumer. Her goal is to provide practical tips to help bring data to life and use it to communicate a story to an audience, with a focus on simplicity and ease of interpretation.

feeds.title: Infogram | Blog
feeds.description: The Infogram Blog is where we share stories, data-driven content, data visualization tips and tricks, and cool charts and infographics. Infogram is a data visualization company that helps people create charts, infographics, maps, and reports.

feeds.title: Highcharts Blog
feeds.description: Highcharts has quickly become one of the industry leaders in JavaScript based data visualization in web pages and web applications.

feeds.title: BI connector Blog
feeds.description: BI Connector offers a simple, secure connection from Tableau to OBIEE for business users, enabling powerful visualization and blending of OBIEE data. Discover all the latest news about BI Connector, BI, analytics, integration, and other trending topics.

feeds.title: PromptCloud | Web Scraping Blog
feeds.description: PromptCloud is a pioneer and global leader in Data-as-a-Service solutions. The integral part of their work is web data extraction using cloud computing technologies focused at helping enterprises acquire large scale structured data from the web.

feeds.title: Policy Viz Blog
feeds.description: Jon Schwabish maintains an excellent site of resources for newbies and professionals alike. One section of note is Remakes, where Schwabish takes an existing chart and offers critique by making a new version. But Schwabish might be known best for The PolicyViz Podcast, a series of interviews with practitioners in the field.

feeds.title: Stephanie Evergreen Data Blog
feeds.description: A blog about Intentional Data Visualization & Evaluation Reporting.

feeds.title: Juice Analytics
feeds.description: Juicebox is a tool for visualizing data. It helps users gather more insights from their data. This blog delivers more insights to readers, by providing posts about using data, visualizing data, and gaining a better understanding of customers through data analysis.

feeds.title: Eagereyes
feeds.description: EagerEyes is Robert Kosara's place to reflect on the world of information visualization and visual communication of data. The goal is to help digest things that are happening in the field and discuss developments that may be tangential or early, but that is likely to have an impact.

feeds.title: The Data Visualisation Catalogue Blog
feeds.description: The Data Visualization Catalogue, helping you find the right data visualization method for your data. The Data Visualization Catalogue is a project developed by Severino Ribecca to create a library of different information visualization types.

feeds.title: Sharp Sight | Data Visualization Blog
feeds.description: Follow this blog to learn high value data science skills

feeds.title: Boost Labs Blog - Insights and Trends in Data Visualization
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date in data visualization and big data by subscribing to the Boost Labs Blog.

feeds.title: Visual Cinnamon Blog

feeds.title: Data Stories
feeds.description: Enrico Bertini and Moritz Stefaner discuss the latest developments in data analytics, visualization and related topics.

feeds.title: DoingData Blog

feeds.title: Info We Trust - RJ Andrews
feeds.description: RJ Andrews is an American data storyteller based in San Francisco.

feeds.title: Annual reports presented as 3D graphs
feeds.description: Presents articles about all kinds of applications for different industries and periods. It's all about showing a large number of financial ratios in comparison: between companies and for different periods using 3D-graph generator.

feeds.title: DataRemixed Blog
feeds.description: Data Remixed is a blog dedicated to all things data: analytics, statistics, visualization, resources, how-to guides, critique and reviews.

feeds.title: BStreams
feeds.description: Covers new features, case studies, do & dont's about data visualization, and data analysis. BStreams helps you to collect and observe your data through visualizations to support your communication in a clear and effective way.

feeds.title: Perceptual Edge Blog

feeds.title: Data Plus Science
feeds.description: Welcome to Data Plus Science by Jeffrey A. Shaffer. He is a regular speaker at conferences, symposiums, universities and corporate training programs on the topic of data visualization, data mining, and Tableau.

feeds.title: Canonicalized
feeds.description: The Learning Center is the place where will always find in-depth, actionable content. We're focused on answering questions with data. If you are looking to do the same, start reading and make sure to come back! We are always working on getting you the most helpful ideas, insights, and guides.

feeds.title: Drawing with Numbers

feeds.title: Jim Vallandingham
feeds.description: A Blog on data visualization & data science by Jim Vallandingham.
